critical_code_review_comments: server.py verify_patient (L1845-1875): correctly captures was_verified BEFORE $set update; role gate require_roles('staff','admin') returns 403 for physician (verified). Dedup guard `decision=='verified' and not was_verified` prevents duplicate notify on re-approve — verified end-to-end. Non-verify decisions and re-saves fall to generic 'Account update' in-portal note only (no email).

notifications.account_verified: single call site, creates 1 in-portal note + 1 email row atomically. _send_email always inserts an outbound_notifications row regardless of send success/failure (status: sent|failed|prepared) — good for auditability; @demo.com correctly logs status='failed' with row present.
email_service.account_verified_html: static server-side template gated by _assert_safe_email; contains no diagnosis/medication/reason/notes; verified programmatically.

Verifications.jsx: uses data-testid='verify-approve' / 'verify-reject'; single POST per click; invalidate + refetch on success — no accidental double-submits observed. The 'VISITA Patient ID (optional)' input is optional and does not affect the notification flow.
